name: impact-experience

frames.best_why: The heading, the first row washed in a warm photo and the next role below it are all visible.
frames.render_note: Left edge is cropped: the title reads "XPERIENCE" and frame 4 cuts "Northline".

tagline: A résumé of past roles, each row flooding with a warm photo on hover.
summary: A light page headed EXPERIENCE, stacked with three job rows. Each row gives the company and dates, a small Position, Location, Industry and Website table, and a pair of paragraphs, and fades in a pink-orange photo when hovered.
appearance: Off-white page with a very large dark EXPERIENCE title sitting on a slightly tinted rounded panel. Beneath it, three full-width rows are divided by thin borders; each has a bold company name and muted dates on the left, a two-column label and value table in the middle, and grey body paragraphs on the right.
behaviour: Hovering a row fades a warm pink, orange and purple photograph in behind all its columns and darkens the grey labels and paragraphs. Moving away cross-fades back to the flat pale panel.
demo_content: Roles at Northline, Habitatly and Brightstack with dates, locations and fintech, real estate and SaaS industries.
search_phrases: work history section for a portfolio
jobs list with company and dates
career timeline for a personal site
rows listing role location and industry
use_when: A personal portfolio or CV page needs a readable, photo-backed list of past roles with details.
avoid_when: Three jobs and all copy are hardcoded, and the row photos need a mouse hover, so touch users never see them.
customise: The three jobs, dates, details and paragraphs are written inside the section; each row's hover photo and the tinted panel colours need source edits.
weight_why: Three static rows with CSS opacity fades on hover; nothing runs on its own.

a11y.note: The company photos only appear on mouse hover, so keyboard and touch users never see them; the hover fades ignore reduced-motion.

issues: The frames crop the left edge, cutting the title to "XPERIENCE".
Row photos are hover-only and unreachable without a pointer.
polish_why: Neat editorial résumé grid with a strong title; hover-only photos and a cropped heading.
